criteria.requirement: Check independent, authorized provenance of source game and donor materials
Compare physically observed clone inventory against the declared B09 count and SHA outside GitHub
Review ownership and redistribution restrictions of the individual staged assets
Compare local receipt with dry-run and native clone in a separate human session
Independently confirm that the B10 configuration belongs to the reviewed B09 clone
Inspect WSB mount paths and read-only flags locally without uploading those paths
Inspect disabled network, clipboard, autostart and guest mapping on the actual host
Verify host Windows Sandbox compatibility and isolation separately from a config JSON
Correlate B11 with its B10 guest session outside the public repository
Review actual engine save directories and completeness of the monitored scopes locally
Inspect before/after results and any differences without publishing save identifiers
Explicitly reject watch_unchanged as proof of global save isolation
Verify physical MapInfos and ownership of occupied native MapIDs
Confirm future regional reservations including Kanto, Johto, Hoenn and planned regions
Independently inspect conflicting and candidate map IDs before approving any allocation
Verify nine symbolic Twinleaf bindings and sixteen real transfers in the isolated clone
Review per-asset source provenance and express permission/redistribution scope
Inspect fourteen real PNGs and renderer compatibility without uploading copyrighted files
Check physical maps, handlers, collision and warp connections after rights approval
Verify real authored PBS compilation and Berry/Rowan event contracts in isolated QA

blockers.description: Proveniência independente de origem e clone físico não comprovada
Configuração Windows Sandbox não verificada em host independente
Escopo limitado dos saves não comprova isolamento global nem vínculo de sessão
MapIDs reais, conflitos e reservas regionais não validados
Direitos de ativos, gráficos, eventos e PBS ainda não aprovados
Gate regional posterior ainda pendente; não constitui teste nativo nem prova física
